title.zh: 分子氢弹性碰撞矩与局部松弛系数

summary: Reduce molecular-hydrogen elastic collision momentum and stress moments independently in each spatial cell, returning normalized coefficients Omega (m^-1), physical frequencies nu (s^-1) and their definedness. A zero denominator retains the collision moment and returns an explicitly undefined frequency; no artificial floor or positive clipping hides it.

capability: Reduce molecular-hydrogen elastic momentum and stress moments per spatial cell into Omega coefficients, collision frequencies and definedness.
operation: Aggregate molecular-hydrogen elastic Omega and collision frequencies
physical distribution, density, two signed Alpha channels, self-collision SIG, velocity weights and cell state -> collision moments, frequencies and status
discovery.model: Moment-matched BGK approximation for momentum and stress; not the full Boltzmann collision operator.
discovery.geometry: Cylindrical (vr, vx) velocity carrier per spatial cell x with N = nvr*nvx Fortran-order matrix indexing; vr and vx normalized by Vth, with Vth, vxi and VxH in physical velocity units and no implicit conversion.
discovery.boundary: Distributions finite and nonnegative, density and integration weights positive, axes strictly increasing, radii and Vth positive, and the density must equal the integral; a zero denominator in an enabled channel is reported through the returned status rather than silently replaced.

identity.relation: molecular H2 elastic Omega_H2_P, Omega_H2_H and Omega_H2_H2 frequency aggregation
identity.direction: physical distribution, density, two signed Alpha channels, self-collision SIG, velocity integration weights and explicit cell state -> collision moments, frequencies and status
identity.definition: Let w_ij = Vr2pidVr_i*dVx_j, n = sum(w*f), u = sum(w*f*vx)/n, U = Vth*u, and K = vr^2 - 2*(vx - u)^2. The central state uses W = sum(w*f*K)/n; the target state uses W = sum(w*(f - M)*K)/n, where M must conserve the cell particle number, mean velocity and total kinetic energy. For the two mixed channels N = sum(w*f*Alpha)/n and d = (U - U_background)/Vth; for self-collision Alpha = SIG_self @ F(f), N = sum(w*f*Alpha)/n and d = W. Omega = N/d and nu = Vth*Omega, with no negative clipping and no floor. The mixed physical acceleration is moment_rate = -beta*Vth^2*N and the self-collision stress rate is -Vth^3*N; atomic beta = (1/2, 2/3) and molecular beta = (1/3, 1/3). When d = 0, Omega/nu = NaN and defined = False, while finite N and moment_rate are still returned. A disabled channel is exactly zero with status disabled. The total frequency is the sum of the three channels and propagates undefined values from enabled channels.
identity.model: a moment-matched BGK approximation for momentum and stress; it is not the full Boltzmann collision operator, and a single-point 0/0 does not determine a unique linearized rate
identity.geometry: cylindrical (vr,vx) velocity carrier per spatial cell x, with N=nvr*nvx Fortran-order matrix indexing
identity.coordinates: vr and vx are normalized by Vth; Vth, vxi and VxH share physical velocity units; no implicit conversion
identity.boundary: finite nonnegative distributions, positive density and integration weights, strictly increasing axes, positive radii and Vth; the density must equal the integral. The target state is verified for conservation in each cell. A zero denominator in an enabled channel is not an input error but an explicitly undefined frequency
assumptions: All velocities use the same Vth; integrating f over the dimensionless velocity volume gives m^-3, SIG already includes the target integration weights, and both Alpha and Omega have units m^-1.

The two Alpha channels must be generated from real background distributions on the same grid and the corresponding SIG; the background flows must match those distributions. This function cannot recover the background distributions from Alpha alone.
The atom, molecule and ion belong to the same H or D isotope, and the mixed-channel mass fractions follow from this; H/D mixed-isotope collisions are not treated as a verified range.

moment_state is central or target and can be selected independently per cell; the target distribution is nonnegative and conserves density, flow velocity and kinetic energy to within 64 binary64 eps of integration roundoff. That tolerance applies only to the conservation check, not to the denominator.

Negative ratios are retained and marked negative_no_bgk_closure, meaning the moment cannot be represented by a nonnegative BGK relaxation rate; such a value is not a usable nonnegative collision frequency.
A Maxwell equilibrium on a finite velocity or angular grid may retain a stress residual; this function retains that residual and does not hide discretization error behind an undefined frequency.

preconditions: the distribution, background Alpha, background mean velocities and SIG use the same isotope, grid, normalization and weights
the caller must inspect defined/status and must not treat a negative coefficient or NaN as a nonnegative BGK frequency
supported: per-cell physical collision moments, central or conserved-target stress differences, and explicitly undefined frequencies
actual discrete Maxwell distributions, weak drift and signed stress; a common velocity shift and spatial partitioning do not change the physical moments
excluded: the full Boltzmann scattering distribution, automatic inversion of background distributions, arbitrary isotope mixing, and a unique equilibrium linearization frequency without a specified perturbation family
experimental universality beyond the cross-section fits and automatic space or angular grid convergence guarantees

failure_semantics.invalid_input: raises ValueError when shapes, real finiteness, distribution nonnegativity, density or weight positivity, axis ordering, boolean flags or target conservation are not satisfied
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: raises ValueError when a collision moment or a frequency that should be defined is not representable as a finite float64
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: this function has no iteration; velocity and angular grid convergence are the caller's responsibility
failure_semantics.partial_results: a complete state mapping is returned; NaN in an enabled zero-denominator channel is an explicit undefined result while the other finite moments are retained, and this is not a partial successful execution

python.signature: assemble_molecular_hydrogen_omega_frequencies(fH2, nH2, Alpha_H2_P, Alpha_H2_H, SIG_H2_H2, Vr2pidVr, dVx, vr, vx, Vth, vxi, VxH, *, moment_state='central', target_distribution=None, H2_P_EL=True, H2_H_EL=True, H2_H2_EL=True)

example.description: generate Alpha from the actual four-channel matrices and a nonnegative physical distribution, then inspect the local moments and the unit conversion
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.collisions import assemble_molecular_hydrogen_collision_matrices, assemble_molecular_hydrogen_omega_frequencies
vr = np.array([0.5, 1.0]); vx = np.array([-1.0, 0.0, 1.0])
wr = np.array([1.0, 2.0]); dx = np.ones(3); w = wr[:, None] * dx
f = np.exp(-vr[:, None]**2 - (vx[None, :] - 0.2)**2)
f *= 2e17 / np.sum(w * f)
bg = np.exp(-vr[:, None]**2 - vx[None, :]**2)
bg *= 3e17 / np.sum(w * bg)
s = assemble_molecular_hydrogen_collision_matrices(vr, vx, wr, dx, 1.0, mu=2.0, n_theta=32)
vth = float(np.sqrt(s['Vth2'][0])); ub = np.array([vth * np.sum(w * bg * vx) / np.sum(w * bg)])
alphas = [(s[k] @ bg.ravel(order='F')).reshape(f.shape, order='F')[:, :, None] for k in ['SIG_H2_P', 'SIG_H2_H']]
r = assemble_molecular_hydrogen_omega_frequencies(f[:, :, None], np.array([2e17]), *alphas, s['SIG_H2_H2'], wr, dx, vr, vx, vth, ub, ub)
assert np.isfinite(r['moment_H2_P']).all()
assert r['defined_H2_P'].all()
np.testing.assert_allclose(r['nu_H2_P'], vth * r['Omega_H2_P'], rtol=1e-14)
example.expected: the mixed collision moments generated from the actual SIG are finite; channels with nonzero drift are defined and nu equals Vth*Omega

scope: the earlier failures around a global state sentinel, molecular central moments with a common velocity shift, and a zero denominator dropping finite moments were reproduced; each is now covered by an item-by-item regression
independent scalar double summation, conservation targets, spatial partitioning, a common velocity shift, negative-ratio status and undefined propagation
Alpha generated from actual fit matrices and normalized Maxwell distributions; H/D adaptive angular integration, weighted exchange relations, equilibrium momentum and two-sided weak drift
verification.evidence_ceiling: supports physical consistency of the given moment model with the tested discrete inputs; it does not represent full project-level application acceptance, nonnegative BGK closure for arbitrary distributions or external experimental accuracy. The candidate asset still requires independent intake acceptance; human scientific approval and public release are decided separately
known_limitations: the moment ratio may be ill-conditioned near a zero denominator; there is no arbitrary floor, and a unique equilibrium linearization rate is not invented from single-point data
a finite angular or velocity grid may produce a Maxwell stress residual; convergence must be checked for the application
the limitations of the cross-section fits, H/D scaling and the molecular-viscosity approximation are inherited; licensing remains to be determined

This is deliberately not source parity for zero/negative denominators: the canonical implementation floors the mixed drift and self-stress denominators and clips every Omega to nonnegative; this asset instead returns NaN with defined=False at a zero denominator and a negative_no_bgk_closure status for a negative ratio. The canonical zero-accumulator sentinel branch selection is replaced by explicit moment_state/target_distribution, so the target branch no longer depends on the sign of a global accumulated target.
The self-collision nu and moment_rate are physical Boltzmann rates when SIG comes from the collision-matrix assets, which use the 3/8 prefactor; they are three times the KN1D values.
